registry_purpose: Machine-readable inventory of mandatory checks that span schema-valid artifacts; this is not an implementation or a pass receipt.

declaration_and_reference_rule.declaration: An entity-creating field in the owning artifact or record.
declaration_and_reference_rule.reference: A foreign-key field that must repeat and resolve one declared ID.

declaration_paths: first canonical embedded evidence entity occurrence
reference_paths: later canonical-byte-identical embedded occurrences with the same evidence_id

declaration_paths: first canonical immutable artifact ref occurrence
reference_paths: later canonical-byte-identical immutable ref occurrences with the same ref_id

checks.rule: Every immutable ref resolves exact bytes, SHA-256, length, media type, and immutability claim.
Declaration IDs are unique in namespace; required repeated references resolve the one declaration; same-ID embedded objects are byte-identical.
Run, attempt, manifest, stimulus, candidate, adapter, harness, runner, environment, dependency-lock, resource, capture, receipt, observation, and oracle bindings agree exactly.
Receipt mapping keys are the exact unique terminal-value JSON Pointer inventory of the sealed observation, excluding only /mapping_receipt_refs.
HARNESS_SUPPLIED targets only schema-listed metadata roots; grader annotations never occur in mapping receipts.
Mapped value digests and every native pointer/range resolve exact values inside complete captured bytes without semantic strengthening.
Action posture and plan status agree with the tuple; complete tuple membership, oracle applicability, exact-loss scope, and reconstruction-boundary evidence are checked across files.

Every truncated artifact retains immutable prefix and truncation evidence, has PARTIAL capture, and terminates exactly as INCOMPLETE/NON_SCOREABLE with reason NATIVE_CAPTURE_TRUNCATED; digest mismatch or byte alteration remains INVALID.

AUTHORIZED trial execution has a resolvable immutable authority ref; other execution authority states have null refs. F5_DUMMY_TRANSPORT_ACCEPT additionally requires trial_class HARNESS_DUMMY, scope F5_DUMMY_TRANSPORT_ONLY, exact immutable 40-hex successor freeze and source refs, the fixed SUCCESSOR_FREEZE_MANIFEST_R2.json path, and an immutable verdict ref resolving to the same bytes as authority_ref; the freeze manifest must resolve at the pinned freeze ref, name the pinned source ref, and pass every path/blob/digest/length check; every non-dummy class rejects that F5-D kind, scope, verdict, and authorization object.
SEALED_HOLDOUT has mutually consistent public/private-manifest commitments, access-log head/audit, custodian release, external ACL evidence, and CASE_KEY oracle refs frozen before execution.
Only OBSERVED may be eligible pending gates; all terminal exceptions remain named, preserved, and non-scoreable.
